title: Explorer
summary: Examine the gap between intent and AI output.
primaryRisk: Accepting fluent output without checking its argument.
humanCheckpoint: Agree the question and constraints before using AI.

title: Practitioner
summary: Build repeatable workflows from individual prompts.
primaryRisk: Private prompts that colleagues cannot reproduce or audit.
humanCheckpoint: Set shared criteria for what to keep and cut.

title: Integrator
summary: Define where people must review AI-supported decisions.
primaryRisk: Rubber-stamping output or reviewing every minor step.

title: Steward
summary: Govern outcomes against the organisation’s standards.
primaryRisk: Outputs converge on competitors’ assumptions and language.
